|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Leia's Resistance Transport (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:V13-L-leiasresistancetransport_ai-2023-12-01-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged; left = previous version, right = this image): [[File:V13-L-leiasresistancetransport_ai-2023-12-01-hires-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
* '''Original''' ([[Leia's Resistance Transport (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 26 August 2022<ref name="img-altpng-3ed4308-leiasresistancetransportaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/leiasresistancetransport_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3ed4308531b909a81d213db4d364fab8c38685fc commit 3ed4308] (26 August 2022) (“GEMP Series 4 AIs, fixes”). The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 1 December 2023<ref name="img-altpng-7c6875b-leiasresistancetransportaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/leiasresistancetransport_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7c6875bd8a1ccc851d821b70ee43fdd7a14c6c44 commit 7c6875b] (1 December 2023) (“Alternate Images Dec 2023”).
